story_fr: La société confirme son objectif de résultat d'exploitation 2026 de 3,45 à 3,69 $ par action, avec un point médian de 3,57 $.
story_en: The company affirms its 2026 operating earnings guidance range of $3.45 to $3.69 per share, midpoint $3.57.
quote: Company affirms its full-year 2026 operating earnings guidance range of $3.45 to $3.69 per share, midpoint of $3.57 per share.

story_fr: Le résultat d'exploitation (non-GAAP) a augmenté à 847 millions $ au premier trimestre 2026, contre 803 millions $ au même trimestre 2025.
story_en: Operating earnings (non-GAAP) rose to $847 million in Q1 2026 from $803 million in Q1 2025.
quote: Operating earnings (non-GAAP) for the three months ended March 31, 2026, were $847 million, compared to $803 million for the same period in 2025.

story_fr: La société prolonge son objectif de croissance annuelle du résultat d'exploitation à 5 %‑7 % jusqu’en 2028‑2030.
story_en: The company extends its long‑term annual operating earnings growth guidance to 5%‑7% through 2028‑2030.
quote: Company extends its existing guidance for long‑term annual operating EPS growth rate of 5% to 7%, with a bias to the upper half for 2028 to 2030.

story_fr: Le revenu net GAAP a baissé à 621 millions $ au premier trimestre 2026, contre 665 millions $ au premier trimestre 2025.
story_en: GAAP net income fell to $621 million in Q1 2026 from $665 million in Q1 2025.
quote: GAAP net income of $0.69 per share; $621 million for the three months ended March 31, 2026, compared with $665 million for the same period in 2025.
